application_credentials.description:
Paste the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from your Azure app registration.

Don't have them yet? Open the [step-by-step setup guide]({more_info_url}) in a new tab. In short: register an app at the Azure portal, add the redirect URI `{redirect_url}` as a **Web** platform, then create a client secret. Come back here and paste both values.
